summary: Iteration 17 — Adviser desk (browser page + APIs) tested end-to-end. 14/14 backend pytest cases pass (desk HTML + security headers, desk login role/password/TTL, refresh, adviser leads access via desk token, lead detail, CSV export, cross-adviser 404, lead_email_html with desk_url View-lead button passes emailer._assert_safe_email, and app-auth regression). 10/10 browser flow steps pass (deep-link to login, wrong-password error, login lands on lead with name/phone/email/unverified-notice/cover-table/existing-cover, session persists across reload, back-to-list and lead-row clicks, CSV download, cross-adviser friendly error, idle timeout simulation via sessionStorage, log out, client-account 403 message). Note: ingress adds extra Cache-Control directives (observed 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate') but 'no-store' is present as required. One tiny cosmetic nit: the header 'Log out' button stays visible on the login card after a failed client-account login (not re-hidden by showLogin()).

minor.issue: Ingress appends to Cache-Control so response header is 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' instead of exactly 'no-store' set by the route. Still contains no-store so functionally meets spec, but if main agent wants exact match it may need to override at ingress/response layer.

ui_bugs.issue: After a failed /api/desk/login attempt from the login screen (e.g. STEP10 client-account 403), the top-right 'Log out' button remains visible on the login card because showLogin() does not explicitly set document.getElementById('logout').hidden=true. logout() does, but showLogin() can be reached from the login-failure path without going through logout(). Cosmetic only (clicking it just calls logout() → showLogin() again). Reference: /app/backend/desk.py:46,60

action_items: (Optional, cosmetic) In desk.py showLogin() set document.getElementById('logout').hidden=true and clear #who, so the Log out chip doesn't linger when the login card is shown after a failed login or deep-link.
(Optional) Consider stripping ingress Cache-Control additions if the exact 'no-store' value is a hard requirement — not blocking, no-store directive is still honoured.
critical_code_review_comments: desk.py is a single-file HTML+inline JS (~140 lines) — manageable; no DRY concerns for current size.
server.py desk_login reuses login() correctly for rate limiting / timing / password check, then enforces adviser role and reads password_version for the 30-min token. Clean.
lead_email_html correctly includes View lead button only when desk_url is passed; href is https and same-host so emailer._assert_safe_email passes.
No MongoDB _id leaking in /api/adviser/leads list or detail responses (verified).
seed_data_creation: None. Used seeded test accounts desk.adviser@example.com / desk.client@example.com and their existing 'Jane Client' lead (6ad755f93f289e4fb34cd701). Cleared db.rate_limits before test run to avoid 429s.
